newsitem.title: USA: Basic Petroleum says Xan field resumed.
newsitem.headline: Basic Petroleum says Xan field resumed.

text.p: Basic Petroleum International Ltd said Monday it has resumed operations at the Xan field in northwestern Guatamala after reaching an agreement that allowed its trucking services to resume.

Drivers employed by the company's supplier of trucking services had gone on strike in mid-November, interrupting oil shipments by truck on La Libertad-Raxruja road. Construction of the pipeline along that route has resumed and is expected to be completed around December 15, the company said.
Production at the Xan field is back at its normal level of about 18,000 barrels per day, the company said.
